etymologies.etymologyHTML: From pollute +‎ -ant.

definitions.definition: A foreign substance that makes something dirty, or impure, especially waste from human activities.

quote.citation: 1987 January 20, “Airborne Pollutants”, in The New York Times‎[1], →ISSN:
quote.text: Acid rain forms when water in the atmosphere condenses on particles containing acid-forming pollutants, such as sulfate produced by the burning of fossil fuels and nitrogen oxides from automobile exhausts.
